biography: Born in Brescia, Italy, Alex Caffi's racing passion ignited early, fueled by his father's tales of Formula One legends. He began karting at age 10, his flashy style and natural talent quickly turning heads. Early success in Formula Three led to a coveted seat with Scuderia Milano, but the team's underfunded operation proved a frustrating experience. A defining moment came during a torrential downpour at the Monza circuit in 2042. Despite starting last, Caffi's audacious overtaking maneuvers and fearless car control saw him climb to a podium finish. Now driving for Bolt-Work G.P., he strives to prove himself as a potential future champion.
drivingStyle: Caffi is known for his aggressive, flamboyant driving style. He's a late-braking specialist, often pushing the limits of his car's grip to gain an advantage in corners. Tire management is a constant challenge for him, as his attacking style tends to wear down the rubber quickly. Under pressure, Caffi can either excel, delivering stunning performances, or crack, making costly errors. He thrives on adrenaline and the roar of the crowd, feeding off the energy to push himself harder.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about just getting from point A to point B. It's about doing it with style, passion, and a little bit of madness."
careerHighlight: His podium finish at the rain-soaked Monza Grand Prix in 2042, after starting last, proved his exceptional talent and car control, earning him widespread recognition.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Monaco Grand Prix in 2043, due to an over-ambitious overtaking attempt, cost him a potentially career-defining victory.
